name: Lawsuits Between Christians
overview: Scripture warns against Christians resorting to lawsuits among themselves, illustrating the folly of a righteous person submitting to the wicked as a corrupt source that troubles others. Jesus challenges the principle of strict retribution, urging believers to transcend 'an eye for an eye' by practicing forgiveness and patience. Additionally, Romans reminds us that civil authorities serve as God's ministers to punish evil, implying that personal vengeance or litigation within the church undermines God's ordained order for justice.
